label: Заметить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for заметить (to notice, spot).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. 'Замечу' is the simple future of perfective заметить, with the т → ч mutation of the first person. It marks one completed act of noticing.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person singular. 'Заметишь' keeps the -ишь ending with no mutation, since т → ч appears only in the first person. 'Очень быстро' frames the single completed event.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Заметит' is the simple future and points to one act of spotting. Its imperfective partner замечать would describe repeated or ongoing noticing.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Заметим' takes the -им ending and promises a single completed observation. 'Сразу' stresses the immediacy of the result.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Заметите' is the respectful -ите future form. 'Среди толпы' uses среди with the genitive to set the scene of the spotting.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Заметил' is the masculine -л past, marking a finished act of noticing. 'Слишком поздно' adds a natural note of regret.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Заметила' adds the feminine -ла ending. 'Новую причёску' is the accusative object of a single completed observation.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Заметили' is the plural -ли past for all genders. 'Странный шум' is the accusative object of a one-time noticing.
Strategic focus: Perfective infinitive. 'Заметить' stays infinitive after the impersonal 'трудно'. The perfective stresses one act of spotting; imperfective замечать would mark habitual noticing.

Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Заметь' is the informal command of заметить, urging the listener to take note at once. It contrasts with imperfective замечай, which invites continual observation.
